def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
    bg=g[0][0] if any(x==g[0][0] for x in g[0]) else 0
    # locate separator line (full-width run of one color != bg)
    line=[r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg]
    lin=r0=line[0] if line else None
    # find objects: contiguous non-bg cells not on line row
    objcells=[]
    for r in range(h):
        if lin is not None and r==lin: continue
        cs=[c for c,x in enumerate(g[r]) if x!=bg]
        if cs: objcells.append((r,cs[0],cs[-1]))
    if not objcells or lin is None: return g
    rows=sorted(set(r for r,_,_ in objcells))
    gap=rows[0]-lin-1
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    for r,c0,c1 in objcells:
        for c in range(c0,c1+1): out[r][c]=bg
    for i,(r,c0,c1) in enumerate(objcells):
        nr=r-gap
        for c in range(c0,c1+1): out[nr][c]=g[r][c]
    bottom=max(rows)+gap
    if lin is not None:
        out[bottom]=[8]*w
    return out

def f(g):
    h=len(g); w=len(g[0]); bg=g[0][0]
    lin=[r for r,row in enumerate(g) if len(set(row))==1 and row[0]!=bg]
    lin=lin[0] if lin else None
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if any(g[r][c]!=bg for c in range(w)) and r!=lin]
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    if not rows or lin is None: return g
    # move object to be flush against line (opposite side), then one row of 8s on far side
    top=min(rows); bot=max(rows)
    if lin < top:
        s = lin+1-top          # top -> lin+1
        r8 = bot+s+1
    else:
        s = lin-1-bot          # bot -> lin-1 ... wait flush means top->lin-1 => s=lin-1-top
        s = lin-1-top
        r8 = top+s-1
    for r in rows:
        for c,x in enumerate(g[r]):
            if x!=bg: out[r][c]=bg
    for r,c,x in [(r,c,g[r][c]) for r in rows for c,x in enumerate(g[r]) if x!=bg]:
        out[r+s][c]=x
    if r8<h: out[r8]=[8]*w
    return out
